evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Cool! Last weekend I started shooting a video for my new album - can't wait for you to check it out! Look how great it was!
[Image caption: a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach]
[S16T6] (dia_id: D16:6)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Can't wait to see it. Will it be shot on location?
[S16T7] (dia_id: D16:7)

Calvin: We're doing the shoot in Miami and picked an awesome beach. It's going to have some epic visuals!
[S16T8] (dia_id: D16:8)

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Yeah Dave, someone even noticed my performance and now we're working together, which is wild. My tour ends soon and I'm heading to Boston. Maybe we can meet up then!
[S15T10] (dia_id: D15:10)

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's awesome! You should be really proud of yourself for bringing joy to others. I booked a flight ticket to Boston last week! I'm so excited about my upcoming trip to Boston. Look at this! See you soon, buddy!
[Image caption: a photo of a book with a boarding pass and a boarding pass]
[S17T6] (dia_id: D17:6)

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Thanks! That studio is great for creativity. I've never been to Boston before, but I hear the parks are amazing. Can't wait to visit next month. Anything cool you remember about Boston parks?
[Image caption: a photo of a tree with pink flowers in the foreground]
[S8T5] (dia_id: D8:5)

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
Calvin: I'm gonna be in Japan for a few months then off to Boston! I can't wait!
[S1T15] (dia_id: D1:15)

Calvin: As you know, I had an amazing experience touring with a well-known artist. The feeling of performing and connecting with the audience was unreal. We ended with a show in Japan and then I had the opportunity to explore my new place - it's like a dream come true!
[S14T4] (dia_id: D14:4)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! I bet playing for an eager audience was an incredible experience. Exploring Japan must have been amazing! How did Tokyo react to your music? Did you have any special moments there?
[S14T5] (dia_id: D14:5)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! That show in Tokyo was awesome! Everyone was so into it when I played one of my songs and sang along. It was a magical moment.
[S14T6] (dia_id: D14:6)
